purpose: Preserve the chronological evolution of EYE, including hypotheses, implementations, failures, controls, runs, verdicts, and next gates. Entries must not erase inconvenient prior states.

entries.summary: EYE was formalized as External-context Yield Extraction: recover bounded semantic regions around opaque or one-way representations by following surviving external bridge invariants, while exact recovery remains OPEN unless an exact verifier matches.
entries.epistemic_lesson: EYE DOES NOT LOOK THROUGH SHA-256. EYE LOOKS AROUND IT.

entries.summary: EYE was bound to advisory SLIME memory and TRUMP routing, then trained over the source-bearing meta-registry as deterministic indexing/graph learning rather than model-weight training. A first write-race with derivative HRAiN memory was preserved and converted into a self-training firewall.
entries.epistemic_lesson: DERIVATIVE MEMORY EXPORT != FRESH SOURCE EVIDENCE

entries.summary: EYE was placed between HRAiN and iNaiHR as a common context-bridge layer while HRAiN retains grounding/mediation and independent verification retains terminal authority.
entries.law: HRAiN GROUNDS. EYE BRIDGES. iNaiHR ASSOCIATES. HRAiN MEDIATES. VERIFY DECIDES.

entries.summary: R2 removed raw word-frequency authority, required cross-domain and independent-lineage support, and searched for recurring epistemic operators. The PALOMAR/MUSIC/GENESIS diagnostic returned CANDIDATE_FOUND__VERIFY_REQUIRED without target boosting.
entries.epistemic_lesson: COMMON OPERATOR != NOVEL BRIDGE. The next target is an ordered combination of operators rather than isolated operator reuse.

entries.summary: R3 is frozen to search for ordered epistemic machines hidden beneath different domain vocabularies. It rewards structural/order/invariant match and independent support while penalizing lexical overlap, lineage overlap, ubiquitous operators, explicit relations and derivative-memory reuse.
central_law: ИЩИ ОДИНАКОВЫЕ МАШИНЫ, СПРЯТАННЫЕ ПОД РАЗНЫМИ СЛОВАМИ.
entries.next_gate: Implement executable miner and CI, run complete derivative-clean registry snapshot, preserve receipt and ranked candidates, then update this journal with the observed result.

entries.summary: The first full R3 run completed successfully and found 370 eligible ordered-machine signatures across 19 recognized domains. PALOMAR/MUSIC/GENESIS produced four candidate machines with zero named-target score bonus. A post-run audit then found that three of the four target sequences were dominated by tied earliest textual anchors, so their ordered-machine interpretation was explicitly downgraded rather than rescued.
entries.epistemic_lesson: DETERMINISTIC TEXTUAL ORDER != VERIFIED MECHANISM ORDER
entries.next_gate: R3.1 strict source-grounded order verification with distinct anchors and every alternate permutation as a negative control.

entries.stage: EYE R3.1 — STRICT ORDER CONSTELLATION GATE
entries.summary: R3.1 re-read the frozen source files, required source SHA-256 agreement, strictly increasing and distinct operator anchors, two independent lineages per domain, and required the candidate order to beat every alternate permutation in every domain. Three R3 target candidates failed for insufficient strict-order support. Exactly one survived the textual-order control gate.
entries.epistemic_lesson: UNTIE THE STARS BEFORE CALLING THEM A CONSTELLATION.
entries.next_gate: R3.2 semantic mechanism verifier: independently map input state -> transformation -> output state for the surviving machine in at least two lineages per domain, then test held-out domain-specific controls. Textual order alone must not be promoted to causal or mechanistic identity.

entries.summary: All eight strict-order source supports were read semantically. Provenance binding and substantive state transitions were present throughout, but the terminal EXACT_VS_SEMANTIC_IDENTITY operator was not semantically the same mechanism across the sources: several cases were merely hash integrity, one was the phrase 'what exactly to verify', and others were source-versus-interpretation or continuity distinctions. The exact R3 machine is therefore downgraded to MISMATCH. A broader recurring JANUS record protocol remains supported: PROVENANCE_BINDING -> STATE_TRANSITION -> IDENTITY_OR_CLAIM_BINDING. The sought shared subject-level Palomar/Music/Genesis scientific mechanism remains OPEN.
entries.epistemic_lesson: EYE FOUND A REAL MACHINE, BUT IT WAS OUR RECORDING MACHINE.
entries.next_gate: EYE R4 — DOMAIN-MECHANISM DECONTAMINATION: model/remove documentation, provenance and governance machines as explicit negative controls, then search subject-level input -> transformation -> output machines on held-out lineages with low lexical overlap and no target boost.

entries.summary: R4 freezes the central upgrade after the R3.2 downgrade: the JANUS CROSS-DOMAIN RECORD COMMIT MACHINE is now an explicit negative control rather than a discovery target. R4 must mask/downweight record and governance surfaces, defeat field-order artifacts, and admit only subject-level input -> transformation -> output candidates that survive independent lineage and held-out controls.
central_law: НЕ ПУТАЙ ОДИНАКОВЫЕ ЗАПИСИ С ОДИНАКОВЫМИ МАШИНАМИ.
ИЩИ ОДИНАКОВУЮ РАБОТУ МИРА ПОД РАЗНЫМИ ПРЕДСТАВЛЕНИЯМИ.
entries.formal_admission: ADMIT(M) only if SUBJECT_SIGNAL(M) > max(RECORD_SIGNAL(M), GOVERNANCE_SIGNAL(M)) and held-out replication passes and negative controls fail to explain M.
entries.epistemic_lesson: THE TELESCOPE IS NOW A CALIBRATION OBJECT, NOT PART OF THE CONSTELLATION.
entries.next_gate: Implement executable R4 miner and CI, run a fresh derivative-clean full-registry snapshot, preserve contamination hits and misses, and only then inspect surviving subject-level machines.

seal: THE JOURNAL REMEMBERS BOTH THE STARS WE FOUND AND THE SKIES THAT STAYED DARK.
